fact: Guineematin reports Orange Finances Mobiles Guinée launched on 12 December 2022 outbound international transfers from Orange Money accounts to Mali, Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Liberia, Sierra Leone and Ghana, in partnership with BNB Transfert Corp, which holds a BCRG transfer licence.
UBA Guinée integrated PAPSS from 9 September 2024, letting its clients make cross-border payments in local currencies across participating African countries.
